original_test_intent: At the controlled 25C reference condition, run the authoritative GPU stress workload and quantitatively compare complete per-GPU behavior with the applicable AMD specification, without erasing the MLperf-versus-RVS-GST conflict.
original_method: Resolve workload/variant identity; pin build and immutable config; map stable GPU to selector; define duration and numeric spec; stabilize DUT at 25C; capture health baseline; execute the approved target-complete workload under independent monitoring; evaluate every metric and error delta; terminate cleanly and confirm post-stress recovery.
manual_activity: Performance/environment owner selects MLperf or GST, approves immutable artifacts, device map, duration/spec oracle and 25C reference condition, and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Approved workload identity and relationship to 10C/45C rows
Pinned ROCm/RVS or MLperf build and immutable configuration
Stable GPU/device-selector map and load-completeness oracle
Duration and exact AMD metric/unit/aggregation/threshold matrix
25C DUT sensor/tolerance/soak, safety limits, watchdog and recovery
safety_requirements: No mutable latest build replacement on an uncontrolled SUT
Do not run until identity, selector and quantitative oracle are approved
Isolate active jobs and monitor per-GPU power/thermal/fan/driver/BMC health
Abort on limit, XID/reset, selection/config or environment anomaly
Preserve baseline and restore process/environment/software state without retry
agent_execution_scope: Await decisions and validate immutable artifacts/target/reference condition
Run one approved workload and compare all metrics
Terminate/recover and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve MLperf versus GST and cross-temperature profile

review_improvement: Makes the nominal reference run a reproducible quantitative comparison while retaining the unresolved source branch.
independent_technical_reasoning: The 25C row is the natural reference for environmental comparison, but it only serves that role if workload binary, configuration, duration and selected GPUs match the hot/cold variants. MLperf and GST cannot share a result oracle by implication. Numeric per-metric acceptance and error deltas are needed because a stress tool may exit successfully despite throttling, partial target use or recovered faults.
